blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday explained that his upcoming visit to France aims to block former lawmaker and fugitive Zaldy Co’s reported bid for asylum there. “As per the latest reports, he’s still there. He is seeking asylum,” Remulla said in a press briefing in Camp Crame.
